class_name EntityService
extends Service

@export var sheep_scene: PackedScene
@export var wolf_scene: PackedScene
@export var sheepdog_scene: PackedScene

var data := AnimalData.new()
var entities: Array[AnimalEntity] = []
var sheep_rows := PackedInt32Array()
var wolf_rows := PackedInt32Array()
var dog_rows := PackedInt32Array()
var container: Node2D
var next_id: int = 1
var capture_count: int = 0
var _next_uid: int = 0

func _reset() -> void:
	for row in range(data.row_to_slot.size()):
		data.identity_alive[row] = int(false)
		data.brain_view[row].reset_tree()
		data.brain_view[row].hide()
	data.active_count = 0
	data.retained_count = 0
	_refresh_rows()
	g_gameplayEngine.grid_service.reset()
	next_id = 1
	capture_count = 0

func _shutdown() -> void:
	clear()
	container = null

func spawn(kind: AnimalEntity.Kind, count: int, at_position := Vector2.INF) -> Array[AnimalEntity]:
	var result: Array[AnimalEntity] = []
	var scene: PackedScene = [sheep_scene, wolf_scene, sheepdog_scene][kind]
	if scene == null or not is_instance_valid(container):
		push_error("EntityService requires animal prefabs and an entity container.")
		return result
	for index in range(count):
		var free_row: int = -1
		for candidate in range(data.retained_count, data.row_to_slot.size()):
			if data.identity_kind[candidate] == kind:
				free_row = candidate
				break
		if free_row < 0:
			free_row = data.append_slot()
			data.identity_kind[free_row] = kind
			var view := scene.instantiate() as AnimalView
			container.add_child(view)
			data.brain_view[free_row] = view
			data.brain_player[free_row] = view.bt_player
		data.swap_rows(free_row, data.retained_count)
		data.swap_rows(data.retained_count, data.active_count)
		var row := data.active_count
		data.active_count += 1
		data.retained_count += 1
		data.brain_view[row].reset_tree()
		data.reset_row(row)
		_next_uid += 1
		data.identity_uid[row] = _next_uid
		if data.handles[row] != null:
			data.handles[row].row = -1
		var animal := AnimalEntity.new()
		animal.slot = data.row_to_slot[row]
		animal.uid = _next_uid
		animal.row = row
		data.handles[row] = animal
		data.brain_view[row].entity = animal
		data.identity_entity_id[row] = next_id
		data.identity_kind[row] = kind
		data.identity_alive[row] = int(true)
		var point: Vector2 = g_gameplayEngine.random_position() if at_position == Vector2.INF else at_position
		data.motion_position[row] = point
		data.motion_movement_goal[row] = point
		data.motion_wander_point[row] = point
		data.motion_facing[row] = Vector2.from_angle(g_gameplayEngine.rng.randf_range(-PI, PI))
		if kind != AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP:
			data.brain_current_behavior[row] = AnimalEntity.Behavior.PATROL
		if kind == AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG:
			data.dog_protection_center[row] = point
			data.dog_patrol_angle[row] = next_id * 2.399963
		g_gameplayEngine.refresh_animal_config(animal)
		data.brain_player[row].active = true
		data.brain_view[row].show()
		data.brain_view[row].sync()
		next_id += 1
		result.append(animal)
	_refresh_rows()
	return result

func spawn_initial() -> void:
	var settings: SimulationConfig = g_gameplayEngine.config
	var counts := settings.get_initial_counts()
	var center: Vector2 = settings.arena_size * 0.5
	for index in range(counts[AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP]):
		var point := center + Vector2(
			g_gameplayEngine.rng.randf_range(-440.0, 440.0),
			g_gameplayEngine.rng.randf_range(-220.0, 220.0))
		spawn(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP, 1, point)

	for index in range(counts[AnimalEntity.Kind.WOLF]):
		var point: Vector2 = g_gameplayEngine.random_position()
		if index % 2 == 0:
			point.x = 40.0
		else:
			point.x = settings.arena_size.x - 40.0
		spawn(AnimalEntity.Kind.WOLF, 1, point)

	for index in range(counts[AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG]):
		var angle := TAU * float(index) / maxf(1.0, counts[AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG])
		spawn(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG, 1, center + Vector2.from_angle(angle) * 100.0)

func _refresh_rows() -> void:
	entities.clear()
	sheep_rows.clear()
	wolf_rows.clear()
	dog_rows.clear()
	for row in range(data.active_count):
		entities.append(data.handles[row])
		data.memory_perception_ready[row] = int(false)
		match data.identity_kind[row]:
			AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP:
				sheep_rows.append(row)
			AnimalEntity.Kind.WOLF:
				wolf_rows.append(row)
			AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG:
				dog_rows.append(row)

func get_counts() -> Vector3i:
	var counts := Vector3i.ZERO
	for row in range(data.active_count):
		if data.identity_alive[row]:
			counts[data.identity_kind[row]] += 1
	return counts

func capture(prey: AnimalEntity) -> bool:
	if data.live(prey) == null:
		return false
	var row := prey.row
	if data.identity_kind[row] != AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP:
		return false
	data.identity_alive[row] = int(false)
	data.identity_death_remaining[row] = g_gameplayEngine.config.death_duration
	data.brain_view[row].reset_tree()
	data.memory_target[row] = null
	data.motion_velocity[row] = Vector2.ZERO
	data.motion_desired_velocity[row] = Vector2.ZERO
	data.brain_current_behavior[row] = AnimalEntity.Behavior.DEAD
	data.brain_view[row].sync()
	capture_count += 1
	g_gameplayEngine.debug_service.clear_invalid_selection()
	return true

func remove_expired(delta: float = 0.0) -> void:
	var changed := false
	var row := 0
	while row < data.active_count:
		if data.identity_alive[row]:
			row += 1
		else:
			data.active_count -= 1
			data.swap_rows(row, data.active_count)
			changed = true
	row = data.active_count
	while row < data.retained_count:
		data.identity_death_remaining[row] -= delta
		if data.identity_death_remaining[row] <= 0.0:
			data.brain_view[row].hide()
			data.retained_count -= 1
			data.swap_rows(row, data.retained_count)
		else:
			row += 1
	if changed:
		_refresh_rows()

func clear() -> void:
	for view in data.brain_view:
		view.entity = null
		view.queue_free()
	data.clear()
	_refresh_rows()
	g_gameplayEngine.grid_service.reset()
	next_id = 1
	capture_count = 0

extends Node

signal simulation_stepped
signal configuration_applied(restarted: bool)

const PRESET_PATH := "user://CFG_Runtime.tres"

@export var config: SimulationConfig
@export_range(1.0, 240.0, 1.0) var simulation_hz: float = 60.0
@export_range(1, 16, 1) var max_steps_per_frame: int = 4
@onready var grid_service: GridService = $GridService
@onready var entity_service: EntityService = $EntityService
@onready var debug_service: DebugService = $DebugService
@onready var profile_service: ProfileService = $ProfileService

var defaults: SimulationConfig
var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
var running: bool = false
var paused: bool = false:
	set(value):
		if paused != value:
			_accumulator = 0.0
			_step_pending = false
		paused = value
var simulation_time: float = 0.0
var step_count: int = 0
var _pending_spawns: Array[Vector2i] = []
var _pending_config: SimulationConfig
var _reset_pending: bool = false
var _step_pending: bool = false
var _accumulator: float = 0.0
var _clock_error_reported: bool = false
var animal_system: AnimalSystem
var sheep_system: SheepSystem
var wolf_system: WolfSystem
var dog_system: SheepdogSystem

func start_simulation(world: Node2D, debug_hud: DebugHUD, settings: SimulationConfig) -> void:
	stop_simulation()
	var error := settings.validate()
	if not error.is_empty():
		push_error(error)
		return

	defaults = settings.copy_config()
	config = settings.copy_config()
	entity_service.container = world.get_node("Animals")
	debug_service.hud = debug_hud
	_create_systems()
	running = true
	grid_service.startup()
	entity_service.startup()
	profile_service.startup()
	debug_service.startup()
	reset_simulation()

func stop_simulation() -> void:
	running = false
	debug_service.shutdown()
	profile_service.shutdown()
	entity_service.shutdown()
	grid_service.shutdown()
	_pending_spawns.clear()
	_pending_config = null
	_reset_pending = false
	_step_pending = false
	_accumulator = 0.0

func reset_simulation() -> void:
	debug_service.reset()
	entity_service.reset()
	profile_service.reset()
	_accumulator = 0.0
	_clock_error_reported = false
	_pending_spawns.clear()
	_reset_pending = false
	_step_pending = false
	rng.seed = config.random_seed
	simulation_time = 0.0
	step_count = 0
	paused = false
	entity_service.spawn_initial()

func request_config_apply(settings: SimulationConfig) -> String:
	var error := settings.validate()
	if not error.is_empty():
		return error
	_pending_config = settings.copy_config()
	return ""

func _apply_pending_config() -> void:
	var restart := _pending_config.requires_restart(config)
	var was_paused := paused
	config = _pending_config
	_pending_config = null
	if restart:
		reset_simulation()
		paused = was_paused
	else:
		for animal in entity_service.entities:
			g_gameplayEngine.refresh_animal_config(animal)
	configuration_applied.emit(restart)

func save_preset(path: String = PRESET_PATH) -> Error:
	var preset := config.copy_config()
	preset.preset_version = SimulationConfig.PRESET_VERSION
	return ResourceSaver.save(preset, path)

func load_preset(path: String = PRESET_PATH) -> SimulationConfig:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		return null
	var loaded := ResourceLoader.load(path, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE) as SimulationConfig
	if loaded == null or loaded.preset_version != SimulationConfig.PRESET_VERSION or not loaded.validate().is_empty():
		return null
	return loaded.copy_config()

func request_spawn(kind: AnimalEntity.Kind, count: int) -> void:
	_pending_spawns.append(Vector2i(kind, count))

func request_reset() -> void:
	_reset_pending = true

func request_single_step() -> void:
	if paused:
		_step_pending = true

func random_position() -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(rng.randf_range(24.0, config.arena_size.x - 24.0),
		rng.randf_range(100.0, config.arena_size.y - 65.0))

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not running:
		return

	# 1) Apply UI commands before iterating entities, including while paused.
	if _pending_config != null:
		_apply_pending_config()
	if _reset_pending:
		reset_simulation()
	for request in _pending_spawns:
		entity_service.spawn(request.x, request.y)
	_pending_spawns.clear()

	var interval := 1.0 / simulation_hz if is_finite(simulation_hz) and simulation_hz > 0.0 else 0.0
	if not is_finite(interval) or interval <= 0.0 or max_steps_per_frame <= 0 or not is_finite(delta) or delta < 0.0:
		_accumulator = 0.0
		_step_pending = false
		if not _clock_error_reported:
			push_error("Simulation interval and step limit must be finite and positive; frame delta must be finite and nonnegative.")
		_clock_error_reported = true
		return
	_clock_error_reported = false
	if paused:
		_accumulator = 0.0
		if _step_pending:
			_step_pending = false
			simulate_step(interval)
		return

	# 2) Calculate a bounded step count and retain only the fractional remainder.
	_accumulator += delta
	var pending_steps := floorf(_accumulator / interval + 0.000000001)
	var steps := int(minf(pending_steps, float(max_steps_per_frame)))
	_accumulator = maxf(0.0, _accumulator - pending_steps * interval)
	for index in range(steps):
		simulate_step(interval)

func simulate_step(delta: float) -> void:
	profile_service.begin_step()
	entity_service.remove_expired()
	# 1) Sample one shared position/velocity snapshot, then resolve dog claims.
	grid_service.rebuild()
	profile_service.end_stage("SpatialBuild")
	entity_service.data.sheep_threat_direction.fill(Vector2.ZERO)
	entity_service.data.sheep_dog_pressure.fill(Vector2.ZERO)
	entity_service.data.sheep_threatened.fill(0)
	wolf_system.accumulate_sheep_pressure()
	dog_system.accumulate_sheep_pressure()
	for row in entity_service.sheep_rows:
		sheep_system.perceive(entity_service.data.handles[row], delta)
	for row in entity_service.wolf_rows:
		wolf_system.perceive(entity_service.data.handles[row], delta)
	for row in entity_service.dog_rows:
		dog_system.perceive(entity_service.data.handles[row], delta)
	profile_service.end_stage("Perception")
	dog_system.assign_tasks()
	profile_service.end_stage("TaskAssignment")

	# 2) Produce movement intent, then move every animal.
	for row in range(entity_service.data.active_count):
		animal_system.decide(entity_service.data.handles[row], delta)
	profile_service.end_stage("Decision")
	animal_system.update_movement(delta)
	profile_service.end_stage("Movement")

	# 3) Resolve howls and captures at the resulting positions.
	for row in entity_service.wolf_rows:
		wolf_system.resolve_interactions(entity_service.data.handles[row], delta)
	profile_service.end_stage("Interaction")
	entity_service.remove_expired(delta)
	for row in range(entity_service.data.active_count):
		entity_service.data.brain_view[row].sync()
	debug_service.advance_visuals(delta)
	simulation_time += delta
	step_count += 1
	profile_service.end_step()
	simulation_stepped.emit()

func _create_systems() -> void:
	animal_system = AnimalSystem.new(entity_service.data)
	sheep_system = SheepSystem.new(entity_service.data)
	wolf_system = WolfSystem.new(entity_service.data)
	dog_system = SheepdogSystem.new(entity_service.data)

func refresh_animal_config(animal: AnimalEntity) -> void:
	var data: AnimalData = g_gameplayEngine.entity_service.data
	var row := animal.row
	data.settings[row] = [config.sheep, config.wolf, config.sheepdog][data.identity_kind[row]]
	data.memory_perception_ready[row] = false
	if data.identity_kind[row] != AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP:
		data.memory_vision_radius_squared[row] = data.settings[row].perception_radius * data.settings[row].perception_radius
		data.memory_vision_cos[row] = cos(deg_to_rad(data.settings[row].vision_angle * 0.5))
	if data.identity_kind[row] == AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG:
		data.dog_assignment_remaining[row] = 0.0

func debug_details(animal: AnimalEntity) -> String:
	var data: AnimalData = g_gameplayEngine.entity_service.data
	var row := animal.row
	var system: RefCounted = [sheep_system, wolf_system, dog_system][data.identity_kind[row]]
	return system.call("get_debug_details", animal)

class_name DebugPanel
extends PanelContainer

const OPTIONS := {
	"wolf_vision": "Wolf vision", "dog_vision": "Dog vision",
	"tracking": "Target tracking", "memory": "Last seen position",
	"movement": "Movement goals", "protection": "Dog protection / collection",
	"howl": "Howl range and pulse",
}

var service: DebugService
var enabled_toggle: CheckBox
var scope: OptionButton
var controls: Dictionary[String, CheckBox] = {}

func _ready() -> void:
	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	for side in ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"]:
		margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_" + side, 12)
	add_child(margin)
	var column := VBoxContainer.new()
	column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	margin.add_child(column)
	var header := HBoxContainer.new()
	column.add_child(header)
	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = "Debug visuals"
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 19)
	title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	header.add_child(title)
	var close_button := Button.new()
	close_button.text = "X"
	close_button.tooltip_text = "Close [Esc]"
	close_button.pressed.connect(close)
	header.add_child(close_button)
	enabled_toggle = CheckBox.new()
	enabled_toggle.text = "Enable overlays [F1]"
	enabled_toggle.toggled.connect(_set_enabled)
	column.add_child(enabled_toggle)
	scope = OptionButton.new()
	scope.add_item("Selected animal only")
	scope.add_item("All animals")
	scope.item_selected.connect(_set_scope)
	column.add_child(scope)
	for key: String in OPTIONS:
		var checkbox := CheckBox.new()
		checkbox.text = OPTIONS[key]
		checkbox.toggled.connect(_set_option.bind(key))
		controls[key] = checkbox
		column.add_child(checkbox)
	var hint := Label.new()
	hint.text = "Visuals only; changes apply immediately.\nSelect an animal by clicking in the arena."
	hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	hint.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	column.add_child(hint)

func initialize(debug_service: DebugService) -> void:
	service = debug_service
	refresh()

func toggle() -> void:
	if visible:
		close()
	else:
		refresh()
		show()

func close() -> void:
	hide()
	get_viewport().gui_release_focus()

func refresh() -> void:
	if service == null:
		return
	enabled_toggle.set_pressed_no_signal(service.show_details)
	scope.select(0 if service.selected_only else 1)
	for key: String in controls:
		controls[key].set_pressed_no_signal(service.visual_options[key])
		controls[key].disabled = not service.show_details

func _set_enabled(value: bool) -> void:
	service.show_details = value
	refresh()

func _set_scope(index: int) -> void:
	service.selected_only = index == 0
	service.howl_events.clear()
	service.refresh()

func _set_option(value: bool, key: String) -> void:
	service.set_visual_option(key, value)

@onready var tabs: TabContainer = $Margin/Column/Tabs
@onready var message: Label = $Margin/Column/Message
@onready var apply_button: Button = $Margin/Column/Actions/Apply
@onready var pause_button: Button = $Margin/Column/Header/Pause

var gameplay_engine: Node
var draft: SimulationConfig
var editors: Dictionary[String, SpinBox] = {}

func _ready() -> void:
	$Margin/Column/Header/Close.pressed.connect(close)
	pause_button.pressed.connect(_toggle_pause)
	apply_button.pressed.connect(_apply)
	$Margin/Column/Actions/Defaults.pressed.connect(_restore_defaults)
	$Margin/Column/Presets/Save.pressed.connect(_save)
	$Margin/Column/Presets/Load.pressed.connect(_load)

func initialize(engine: Node) -> void:
	gameplay_engine = engine
	if not engine.configuration_applied.is_connected(_on_applied):
		engine.configuration_applied.connect(_on_applied)
	set_draft(engine.config)

func toggle() -> void:
	if visible:
		close()
	else:
		set_draft(gameplay_engine.config)
		show()

func close() -> void:
	hide()
	get_viewport().gui_release_focus()

func set_draft(settings: SimulationConfig) -> void:
	draft = settings.copy_config()
	var selected_tab := maxi(0, tabs.current_tab)
	for child in tabs.get_children():
		tabs.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	editors.clear()

	for section_name: String in draft.get_sections():
		var section: Resource = draft.get_sections()[section_name]
		var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
		scroll.name = section_name
		scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
		tabs.add_child(scroll)
		var rows := VBoxContainer.new()
		rows.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		rows.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 7)
		scroll.add_child(rows)

		var group_name: String = ""
		for property in section.get_property_list():
			if (property.usage & PROPERTY_USAGE_GROUP) != 0:
				group_name = property.name
				continue
			if (property.usage & PROPERTY_USAGE_EDITOR) == 0 or property.hint != PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE:
				continue
			if not group_name.is_empty():
				var heading := Label.new()
				heading.text = group_name
				heading.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#b8d94b"))
				heading.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
				rows.add_child(heading)
				group_name = ""
			_add_editor(rows, section_name, section, property)

	tabs.current_tab = mini(selected_tab, tabs.get_tab_count() - 1)
	_update_apply_state()
	refresh()

func _add_editor(rows: VBoxContainer, section_name: String, section: Resource, property: Dictionary) -> void:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	rows.add_child(row)
	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = str(property.name).capitalize()
	label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	label.tooltip_text = FIELD_HELP.get(section_name + "." + str(property.name), label.text)
	row.add_child(label)

	var spin := SpinBox.new()
	spin.name = property.name
	spin.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(124, 30)
	var limits: PackedStringArray = property.hint_string.split(",")
	spin.min_value = limits[0].to_float()
	spin.max_value = limits[1].to_float()
	spin.step = limits[2].to_float() if limits.size() > 2 else 1.0
	spin.set_value_no_signal(float(section.get(property.name)))
	spin.tooltip_text = label.tooltip_text
	row.add_child(spin)
	editors[section_name + "." + str(property.name)] = spin
	spin.value_changed.connect(_value_changed.bind(section_name, property.name, property.type))

func _value_changed(value: float, section_name: String, property_name: StringName, value_type: int) -> void:
	var section: Resource = draft.get_sections()[section_name]
	section.set(property_name, int(value) if value_type == TYPE_INT else value)
	_update_apply_state()

func _update_apply_state() -> void:
	var error := draft.validate()
	apply_button.disabled = not error.is_empty()
	var restart := draft.requires_restart(gameplay_engine.config)
	apply_button.text = "Apply & restart" if restart else "Apply"
	if not error.is_empty():
		message.text = error
	elif restart:
		var counts := draft.get_initial_counts()
		message.text = "Apply restarts the simulation. Initial population: %d sheep, %d wolves, %d dogs." % [counts.x, counts.y, counts.z]
	else:
		message.text = "Apply updates current animals. Elapsed timers are preserved; new thresholds apply next step."

func _apply() -> void:
	# 1) Commit text fields before validating the complete draft.
	for spin in editors.values():
		spin.apply()
	var error: String = gameplay_engine.request_config_apply(draft)
	if error.is_empty():
		message.text = "Applying..."
		apply_button.disabled = true
		get_viewport().gui_release_focus()
	else:
		message.text = error

func _on_applied(restarted: bool) -> void:
	set_draft(gameplay_engine.config)
	message.text = "Applied and restarted. Pause state preserved." if restarted else "Applied to current and newly spawned animals."

func _restore_defaults() -> void:
	set_draft(gameplay_engine.defaults)
	message.text = "Default CFG values loaded into the form. Apply when ready."

func _save() -> void:
	var result: Error = gameplay_engine.save_preset()
	message.text = "Applied settings saved to CFG_Runtime.tres." if result == OK else "Could not save preset: " + error_string(result)

func _load() -> void:
	var loaded: SimulationConfig = gameplay_engine.load_preset()
	if loaded == null:
		message.text = "Preset missing or incompatible. Only behavior preset version %d is supported; other files are preserved." % SimulationConfig.PRESET_VERSION
		return
	set_draft(loaded)
	message.text = "Saved preset loaded into the form. Apply when ready."

func _toggle_pause() -> void:
	gameplay_engine.paused = not gameplay_engine.paused
	get_viewport().gui_release_focus()
	refresh()

func refresh() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(gameplay_engine):
		pause_button.text = "Resume" if gameplay_engine.paused else "Pause"

class_name SheepSystem
extends RefCounted

var data: AnimalData

func _init(storage: AnimalData) -> void:
	data = storage

func _scan_neighbors(animal: AnimalEntity, grid: GridService) -> void:
	var row := animal.row
	var cell := grid.row_cells[row]
	var count := grid.flock_counts[cell] - 1
	var aligned := grid.alignment_counts[cell] - 1
	data.sheep_local_flock_center[row] = (grid.flock_position_sums[cell] - grid.perception_positions[row]) / count if count > 0 else grid.perception_positions[row]
	data.sheep_neighbor_count[row] = count
	data.sheep_alignment[row] = (grid.alignment_velocity_sums[cell] - grid.perception_velocities[row]) / aligned if aligned > 0 else Vector2.ZERO

func receive_howl(animal: AnimalEntity, source: Vector2) -> void:
	var row := animal.row
	data.sheep_panic_source[row] = source
	data.sheep_panic_elapsed[row] = 0.0
	data.sheep_has_panic[row] = 1
	data.sheep_has_alert[row] = 1
	data.sheep_alert_elapsed[row] = 0.0

func perceive(animal: AnimalEntity, delta: float) -> void:
	var row := animal.row
	var settings: SheepConfig = data.settings[row]
	var common: AnimalSystem = g_gameplayEngine.animal_system
	common.perceive(animal, delta)
	var position := data.motion_position[row]
	var threatened: bool = data.sheep_threatened[row] != 0
	var threat_direction := data.sheep_threat_direction[row]
	var panic_elapsed := data.sheep_panic_elapsed[row]
	var has_panic: bool = data.sheep_has_panic[row] != 0
	if has_panic:
		panic_elapsed += delta
		has_panic = panic_elapsed < settings.panic_duration
		if has_panic:
			threat_direction += (position - data.sheep_panic_source[row]).normalized()
	var alert_elapsed := data.sheep_alert_elapsed[row]
	var has_alert: bool = data.sheep_has_alert[row] != 0
	if threatened or has_panic:
		has_alert = true
		alert_elapsed = 0.0
	else:
		alert_elapsed += delta
		has_alert = has_alert and alert_elapsed < settings.alert_duration
	if (threatened or has_panic) and threat_direction.is_zero_approx():
		threat_direction = Vector2.from_angle(data.identity_entity_id[row] * 2.399963)
	data.sheep_threatened[row] = int(threatened)
	data.sheep_threat_direction[row] = threat_direction
	data.sheep_panic_elapsed[row] = panic_elapsed
	data.sheep_has_panic[row] = int(has_panic)
	data.sheep_alert_elapsed[row] = alert_elapsed
	data.sheep_has_alert[row] = int(has_alert)

func get_flock_velocity(animal: AnimalEntity) -> Vector2:
	var row := animal.row
	var settings: SheepConfig = data.settings[row]
	var cohesion := (data.sheep_local_flock_center[row] - data.motion_position[row]).normalized() if data.sheep_neighbor_count[row] > 0 else Vector2.ZERO
	return data.sheep_alignment[row] * settings.alignment_weight + cohesion * settings.move_speed * settings.cohesion_weight

func apply_steering(animal: AnimalEntity, steering: Vector2, flock: Vector2, speed: float, delta: float) -> void:
	var row := animal.row
	var settings: SheepConfig = data.settings[row]
	var common: AnimalSystem = g_gameplayEngine.animal_system
	steering += flock + data.motion_separation[row] * settings.move_speed * settings.separation_weight
	var margin: float = 40.0
	var lower := Vector2(12.0, 94.0) + Vector2.ONE * margin
	var upper: Vector2 = g_gameplayEngine.config.arena_size - Vector2(12.0, 58.0) - Vector2.ONE * margin
	var boundary := (lower - data.motion_position[row]).max(Vector2.ZERO) - (data.motion_position[row] - upper).max(Vector2.ZERO)
	steering += boundary / margin * speed * 2.0
	var desired := data.motion_velocity[row].lerp(steering.limit_length(speed), minf(1.0, settings.steering_rate * delta))
	common.submit_velocity(animal, desired, speed)

func get_debug_details(animal: AnimalEntity) -> String:
	var row := animal.row
	var settings: SheepConfig = data.settings[row]
	return "Neighbors %d | Alert %.1f s | Panic %.1f s" % [data.sheep_neighbor_count[row], maxf(0.0, settings.alert_duration - data.sheep_alert_elapsed[row]) if data.sheep_has_alert[row] else 0.0, maxf(0.0, settings.panic_duration - data.sheep_panic_elapsed[row]) if data.sheep_has_panic[row] else 0.0]

func _generate_name() -> String:
	return "Check " + str(condition)

func _tick(_delta: float) -> Status:
	if not is_instance_valid(agent):
		return FAILURE
	var animal := agent.entity as AnimalEntity
	if animal == null or animal.row < 0 or not data.identity_alive[animal.row]:
		return FAILURE
	var met := false
	match condition:
		&"has_threat":
			met = data.sheep_threatened[animal.row] or data.sheep_has_panic[animal.row] if data.identity_kind[animal.row] == AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP else data.live(data.memory_target[animal.row]) != null
		&"is_alert":
			met = data.sheep_has_alert[animal.row] != 0
		&"is_herded":
			met = not data.sheep_dog_pressure[animal.row].is_zero_approx()
		&"has_nearby_dog":
			met = data.live(data.wolf_nearest_threat[animal.row]) != null
		&"needs_rest":
			met = data.wolf_resting[animal.row] or (data.wolf_retreating[animal.row] and data.live(data.wolf_nearest_threat[animal.row]) == null)
		&"has_lost_prey":
			met = data.wolf_hunting[animal.row] and not data.memory_target_visible[animal.row]
		&"has_prey":
			met = data.wolf_hunting[animal.row]
		&"can_charge":
			met = g_gameplayEngine.wolf_system.can_charge(animal)
		&"must_return":
			met = data.dog_returning[animal.row] != 0
		&"has_stray":
			met = data.live(data.dog_collected_sheep[animal.row]) != null
	return SUCCESS if met else FAILURE

	var wolf := agent.entity as AnimalEntity

	var common: AnimalSystem = g_gameplayEngine.animal_system
	var point: Vector2 = data.memory_last_seen_position[wolf.row]

				data.wolf_howled[wolf.row] = 1

	common.move_towards(wolf, common.clamp_to_arena(wolf, point), settings.move_speed, delta)

	debug.record_howl(wolf)
	debug.advance_visuals(0.3)

	_check(not debug.visual_options["tracking"] and debug.selected == wolf, "checkbox input updates tracking without click-through")

	panel.scope.item_selected.emit(1)
	debug.record_howl(wolf)
	debug.advance_visuals(0.3)
	await _capture("all-animals")
	await _key(KEY_F2)

	var has_sampling := false

	for argument in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if argument.begins_with("--entry="):
			continue
		var parts := argument.split("=", true, 1)
		if parts.size() != 2:
			_fail("Expected --name=value: " + argument)
			return
		var value := parts[1]
		match parts[0]:
			"--main-scene":
				if value not in ["on", "off"]:
					_fail("--main-scene must be on or off")
					return
				main_scene = value == "on"
			"--steps", "--warmup-steps":
				if not value.is_valid_int() or value.to_int() < 0:
					_fail("Expected nonnegative step count: " + argument)
					return
				if parts[0] == "--steps":
					fixed_steps = value.to_int()
				else:
					warmup_steps = value.to_int()
			"--entities", "--tier", "--tiles", "--max-fps":
				if not value.is_valid_int():
					_fail("Expected integer: " + argument)
					return
				match parts[0]:
					"--entities":
						has_entities = true
						entities_count = value.to_int()
					"--tier":
						has_tier = true
						tier = value.to_int()
					"--tiles":
						has_tiles = true
						tiles = value.to_int()
					"--max-fps":
						max_fps = value.to_int()
			"--duration", "--warmup":
				if not value.is_valid_float():
					_fail("Expected seconds: " + argument)
					return
				if parts[0] == "--duration":
					duration = value.to_float()
				else:
					warmup = value.to_float()
			"--scenario":
				scenario = value
			"--layout":
				has_layout = true
				layout = value
			"--sampling":
				if value not in ["off", "stages", "detailed"]:
					_fail("--sampling must be off, stages or detailed")
					return
				has_sampling = true
				sampling = value
			"--hud", "--animals":
				if value not in ["on", "off"]:
					_fail("Expected on or off: " + argument)
					return
				match parts[0]:
					"--hud":
						hud_visible = value == "on"
					"--animals":
						animals_visible = value == "on"
			"--overlay":
				if value not in ["off", "on", "details"]:
					_fail("--overlay must be off, on or details")
					return
				overlay = value
			"--label":
				if value.is_empty() or not value.replace("-", "").replace("_", "").is_valid_identifier():
					_fail("Invalid benchmark label")
					return
				label = value
			"--stats":
				if value not in ["on", "off"]:
					_fail("--stats must be on or off")
					return
				stats_enabled = value == "on"
			_:
				_fail("Unknown argument: " + argument)
				return
	if not has_sampling:
		sampling = "stages" if stats_enabled else "off"

	if tier < 1 or max_fps < 0 or not is_finite(duration) or duration <= 0.0 or not is_finite(warmup) or warmup < 0.0:

		return

func _prepare_exact_settings(settings: SimulationConfig) -> void:
	if scenario != "scaled":
		return
	var base_total := settings.initial_total
	if base_total == 0:
		return
	var ratio := float(entities_count) / base_total
	settings.arena_size *= sqrt(ratio)

func _spawn_exact_layout() -> void:
	var positions_rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	positions_rng.seed = engine.config.random_seed
	var lower := Vector2(12.0, 94.0)
	var upper: Vector2 = engine.config.arena_size - Vector2(12.0, 58.0)
	for kind in range(3):
		for index in range(configured_counts[kind]):
			var point := Vector2(positions_rng.randf_range(lower.x, upper.x), positions_rng.randf_range(lower.y, upper.y))
			engine.entity_service.spawn(kind, 1, point)

func _spawn_layout(base_size: Vector2) -> void:
	var positions_rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	positions_rng.seed = engine.config.random_seed
	var regions := tiles * tiles
	for region in range(regions):
		var offset := Vector2(region % tiles, floori(float(region) / tiles)) * base_size
		if layout == "cluster":
			offset = (engine.config.arena_size - base_size) * 0.5
		for kind in range(3):
			var count := configured_counts[kind] / regions + (1 if region < configured_counts[kind] % regions else 0)
			for index in range(count):
				var point := base_size * 0.5
				match kind:
					AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP:
						point += Vector2(positions_rng.randf_range(-440.0, 440.0), positions_rng.randf_range(-220.0, 220.0))
					AnimalEntity.Kind.WOLF:
						point = Vector2(40.0 if index % 2 == 0 else base_size.x - 40.0, positions_rng.randf_range(100.0, base_size.y - 65.0))
					AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG:
						point += Vector2.from_angle(TAU * float(index) / maxi(1, count)) * 100.0
				engine.entity_service.spawn(kind, 1, point + offset)

func _process(_delta: float) -> bool:
	if fixed_steps > 0:
		return false
	if ready_time == 0 or done:
		return false

	var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	if started == 0:
		if (now - ready_time) / 1000000.0 >= warmup:
			started = now
			last_frame = now
			last_sample = now
			initial_counts = engine.entity_service.get_counts()
			sim_started = engine.simulation_time
			capture_started = engine.entity_service.capture_count
			engine.profile_service.reset()
		return false

	frame_steps.append(float(pending_frame_steps))
	frame_simulation_ms.append(pending_frame_simulation_ms)
	pending_frame_steps = 0
	pending_frame_simulation_ms = 0.0
	frames += 1
	frame_times.append((now - last_frame) / 1000.0)
	last_frame = now
	var elapsed := (now - started) / 1000000.0
	if now - last_sample >= 1000000:
		var counts: Vector3i = engine.entity_service.get_counts()
		_record_sample(elapsed)
		print("BENCHMARK_SAMPLE tier=%d wall=%.1f loop_hz=%.1f step_ms=%.2f alive=%s sim=%.1f" % [
			tier, elapsed, frames / elapsed, engine.profile_service.last_step_ms, counts, engine.simulation_time])
		last_sample = now
	if elapsed >= duration:
		_finish(elapsed)
	return false

func _record_step() -> void:
	if started > 0 and not done:
		pending_frame_steps += 1
		pending_frame_simulation_ms += engine.profile_service.last_step_ms
		step_times.append(engine.profile_service.last_step_ms)
		perception_total += engine.profile_service.last_perception_ms
		decision_total += engine.profile_service.last_decision_ms
		movement_total += engine.profile_service.last_movement_ms
		for name in stage_totals:
			stage_totals[name] += engine.profile_service.last_stages_ms[name]
		for name in hotspot_totals:
			hotspot_totals[name] += engine.profile_service.last_hotspots_ms[name]
			hotspot_calls[name] += engine.profile_service.last_hotspot_calls[name]
		var service: GridService = engine.grid_service
		spatial_queries += service.spatial_query_count
		spatial_candidates += service.spatial_candidate_count
		spatial_max_candidates = maxi(spatial_max_candidates, service.spatial_max_candidates)
		spatial_max_occupancy = maxi(spatial_max_occupancy, service.spatial_max_occupancy)
		spatial_cells_total += service.spatial_nonempty_cells

func _record_sample(elapsed: float) -> void:
	var counts: Vector3i = engine.entity_service.get_counts()
	var steps := step_times.size() - window_step_index
	var sample := {"wall_seconds": elapsed, "window_wall_seconds": elapsed - window_elapsed,
		"simulation_seconds": engine.simulation_time, "simulation_steps": steps, "physics_steps": steps,
		"sheep": counts.x, "wolves": counts.y, "dogs": counts.z,
		"loop_hz_average_so_far": frames / elapsed, "last_step_ms": engine.profile_service.last_step_ms,
		"window_loop_hz": (frames - window_frame_index) / maxf(0.000001, elapsed - window_elapsed),
		"step_mean_ms": _mean(step_times.slice(window_step_index)),
		"step_p95_ms": _percentile(step_times.slice(window_step_index), 0.95),
		"frame_p95_ms": _percentile(frame_times.slice(window_frame_index), 0.95),
		"stages_mean_ms": {}, "hotspots": {}, "debug": {},
		"draw_calls": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME),
		"rendered_objects": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_OBJECTS_IN_FRAME),
		"primitives": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.RENDER_TOTAL_PRIMITIVES_IN_FRAME),
		"process_ms": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PROCESS) * 1000.0,
		"physics_process_ms": Performance.get_monitor(Performance.TIME_PHYSICS_PROCESS) * 1000.0}
	for name in stage_totals:
		sample.stages_mean_ms[name] = (stage_totals[name] - window_stage_totals[name]) / maxi(1, steps)
		window_stage_totals[name] = stage_totals[name]
	for name in hotspot_totals:
		var total: float = hotspot_totals[name] - window_hotspot_totals[name]
		var calls: int = hotspot_calls[name] - window_hotspot_calls[name]
		sample.hotspots[name] = {"total_ms": total, "calls": calls, "mean_per_step_ms": total / maxi(1, steps), "mean_per_call_ms": total / maxi(1, calls)}
		window_hotspot_totals[name] = hotspot_totals[name]
		window_hotspot_calls[name] = hotspot_calls[name]
	for name in engine.profile_service.debug_totals_ms:
		var total: float = engine.profile_service.debug_totals_ms[name] - window_debug_ms[name]
		var calls: int = engine.profile_service.debug_calls[name] - window_debug_calls[name]
		sample.debug[name] = {"total_ms": total, "calls": calls, "mean_per_call_ms": total / maxi(1, calls)}
		window_debug_ms[name] = engine.profile_service.debug_totals_ms[name]
		window_debug_calls[name] = engine.profile_service.debug_calls[name]
	samples.append(sample)
	window_step_index = step_times.size()
	window_frame_index = frames
	window_elapsed = elapsed

func _mean(values: Array[float]) -> float:
	var total: float = 0.0
	for value in values:
		total += value
	return total / maxi(1, values.size())

func _percentile(values: Array[float], fraction: float) -> float:
	if values.is_empty():
		return 0.0
	var sorted: Array[float] = values.duplicate()
	sorted.sort()
	return sorted[mini(sorted.size() - 1, int(ceil(sorted.size() * fraction)) - 1)]

func _finish(elapsed: float) -> void:
	done = true
	var counts: Vector3i = engine.entity_service.get_counts()
	if elapsed > window_elapsed:
		_record_sample(elapsed)
	var stages_mean: Dictionary = {}

		stages_mean[name] = stage_totals[name] / maxi(1, step_times.size())

			"mean_per_call_ms": engine.profile_service.debug_totals_ms[name] / maxi(1, engine.profile_service.debug_calls[name])}
	var result := {

		"cpu": OS.get_processor_name(), "gpu": RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name(),
		"renderer": RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method(),
		"display_driver": DisplayServer.get_name(), "viewport": [root.size.x, root.size.y],
		"camera_zoom": scene.get_node("Camera2D").zoom.x, "vsync": false,
		"max_fps": Engine.max_fps, "physics_hz": Engine.physics_ticks_per_second,
		"simulation_hz": engine.simulation_hz, "max_steps_per_frame": engine.max_steps_per_frame,

		"measured_wall_seconds": elapsed, "process_iterations": frames,

		"simulation_steps": step_times.size(), "physics_steps": step_times.size(), "step_mean_ms": _mean(step_times),
		"steps_per_frame_mean": _mean(frame_steps), "steps_per_frame_p95": _percentile(frame_steps, 0.95),

	var path := run_directory + "/result.json"

	print("BENCHMARK_RESULT ", path, " ", JSON.stringify(result))
	engine.stop_simulation()

	call_deferred("quit", 0)

func _verify_clock() -> void:
	var data: AnimalData = g_gameplayEngine.entity_service.data
	_empty(false)
	engine.simulation_hz = 60.0
	engine.max_steps_per_frame = 4
	engine.paused = false
	var interval: float = 1.0 / engine.simulation_hz
	engine._process(interval * 0.4)
	_check(engine.step_count == 0 and is_equal_approx(engine._accumulator, interval * 0.4), "fractional frame waits for a full step")
	engine._process(interval * 0.6)
	_check(engine.step_count == 1 and is_zero_approx(engine._accumulator), "accumulated full step advances once")
	engine.reset_simulation()
	engine._process(interval * 6.4)
	_check(engine.step_count == 4 and is_equal_approx(engine._accumulator, interval * 0.4), "catch-up is bounded and retains only fractional remainder")
	engine._process(0.0)
	_check(engine.step_count == 4, "discarded backlog is not replayed")
	engine._process(interval * 0.6)
	_check(engine.step_count == 5, "fractional remainder carries into next frame")
	engine.reset_simulation()
	engine._process(interval * 0.4)
	engine.paused = true
	engine._process(100.0)
	_check(engine.step_count == 0 and engine._accumulator == 0.0, "pause discards fractional time and accrues no debt")
	engine.paused = false
	engine._process(interval * 0.6)
	_check(engine.step_count == 0, "resume starts with a fresh accumulator")
	engine._process(interval * 0.4)
	_check(engine.step_count == 1, "resume advances after a new full interval")
	engine.reset_simulation()
	engine.simulation_hz = 30.0
	engine.paused = true
	engine.request_single_step()
	engine._process(0.0)
	_check(engine.step_count == 1 and is_equal_approx(engine.simulation_time, 1.0 / 30.0), "single step uses configured interval")
	engine._process(10.0)
	_check(engine.step_count == 1, "single-step request is consumed once")
	engine.paused = false
	engine._process(0.01)
	engine.reset_simulation()
	_check(engine._accumulator == 0.0 and engine.step_count == 0, "reset clears accumulated time")
	var errors_enabled := Engine.print_error_messages
	Engine.print_error_messages = false
	var invalid_results: Array[bool] = []
	for frequency in [0.0, -1.0, NAN, INF, 1.0e-320]:
		engine.simulation_hz = frequency
		engine._process(1.0)
		invalid_results.append(engine.step_count == 0 and engine._clock_error_reported)
	engine.simulation_hz = 60.0
	engine.max_steps_per_frame = 0
	engine._process(1.0)
	invalid_results.append(engine.step_count == 0 and engine._clock_error_reported)
	engine.max_steps_per_frame = 4
	for frame_delta in [NAN, INF, -1.0]:
		engine._process(frame_delta)
		invalid_results.append(engine.step_count == 0 and engine._clock_error_reported)
	Engine.print_error_messages = errors_enabled
	for result in invalid_results:
		_check(result, "invalid clock input prevents automatic stepping")
	engine._process(1.0 / 60.0)
	_check(engine.step_count == 1 and not engine._clock_error_reported, "valid configuration resumes automatic stepping")
	_empty(false)
	engine.config.initial_total = 30
	engine.config.sheep_ratio = 24.0
	engine.config.wolf_ratio = 4.0
	engine.config.sheepdog_ratio = 2.0
	engine.reset_simulation()
	for index in range(120):
		engine._process(1.0 / 60.0)
	var expected: Array = [engine.rng.state, engine.entity_service.capture_count]
	for animal in engine.entity_service.entities:
		expected.append([data.identity_entity_id[animal.row], data.motion_position[animal.row], data.motion_velocity[animal.row], data.brain_current_behavior[animal.row]])
	engine.reset_simulation()
	for index in range(60):
		engine._process(1.0 / 120.0)
		engine._process(3.0 / 120.0)
	var actual: Array = [engine.rng.state, engine.entity_service.capture_count]
	for animal in engine.entity_service.entities:
		actual.append([data.identity_entity_id[animal.row], data.motion_position[animal.row], data.motion_velocity[animal.row], data.brain_current_behavior[animal.row]])
	_check(engine.step_count == 120 and expected == actual and is_zero_approx(engine._accumulator), "frame grouping preserves seeded simulation at equal step count")
	engine.reset_simulation()
	engine._process(interval * 0.4)
	var replacement: SimulationConfig = engine.config.copy_config()
	replacement.initial_total = 1
	replacement.sheep_ratio = 1.0
	replacement.wolf_ratio = 0.0
	replacement.sheepdog_ratio = 0.0
	engine.request_config_apply(replacement)
	engine._process(0.0)
	_check(engine._accumulator == 0.0 and engine.step_count == 0 and engine.entity_service.get_counts().x == 1, "configuration restart clears partial step")

func _verify_ecs_storage() -> void:
	_empty()
	var service: EntityService = engine.entity_service
	service.clear()
	var data := service.data
	var prey := _animal(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP, Vector2(500, 300))
	var wolf := _animal(AnimalEntity.Kind.WOLF, Vector2(100, 300))
	var dog := _animal(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG, Vector2(900, 300))
	data.memory_target[wolf.row] = prey
	data.dog_protected_sheep[dog.row] = prey
	data.dog_collected_sheep[dog.row] = prey
	var old_uid := prey.uid
	var old_slot := prey.slot
	var view := data.brain_view[prey.row]
	var player := data.brain_player[prey.row]
	player.get_blackboard().set_var(&"reuse_test", 42)
	data.sheep_has_panic[prey.row] = 1
	data.motion_velocity[prey.row] = Vector2(20, 10)
	data.motion_velocity[dog.row] = Vector2(7, 9)
	data.dog_protection_center[dog.row] = Vector2(800, 250)
	var dog_uid := dog.uid
	engine.debug_service.selected = prey
	_check(service.capture(prey) and not service.capture(prey), "death captures exactly once")
	_check(data.live(data.memory_target[wolf.row]) == null and engine.debug_service.selected == null, "death invalidates target and selection immediately")
	service.remove_expired()
	_check(not prey.enabled and view.visible and not player.active, "disabled life keeps a short corpse presentation")
	_check(data.active_count == 2 and data.retained_count == 3 and not service.entities.has(prey), "corpse is outside the contiguous active prefix")
	_check(dog.row == 0 and dog.uid == dog_uid and data.motion_position[dog.row] == Vector2(900, 300) and data.motion_velocity[dog.row] == Vector2(7, 9) and data.dog_protection_center[dog.row] == Vector2(800, 250), "row swap preserves identity and independent component fields")
	_check(data.brain_view[dog.row].entity == dog and data.live(data.dog_collected_sheep[dog.row]) == null, "row swap preserves scene association and invalidates dog references")
	for row in range(data.row_to_slot.size()):
		_check(data.slot_to_row[data.row_to_slot[row]] == row, "slot mapping follows row swap")
	var remaining := data.identity_death_remaining[prey.row]
	engine._process(1.0)
	_check(data.identity_death_remaining[prey.row] == remaining, "pause freezes corpse lifetime")
	var extra := _animal(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP, Vector2(700, 400))
	_check(extra.slot != old_slot and view.visible, "spawning cannot reuse a visible corpse")
	_step(20)
	_check(not view.visible and data.retained_count == data.active_count, "expired corpse enters the reusable suffix")
	var allocated := data.row_to_slot.size()
	var replacement := _animal(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEP, Vector2(600, 400))
	_check(replacement.slot == old_slot and replacement.uid != old_uid and data.row_to_slot.size() == allocated, "reuse keeps the slot and allocates a new uid without growing storage")
	_check(data.row_of(prey) == -1 and data.live(prey) == null and data.live(data.memory_target[wolf.row]) == null, "old life handle cannot follow a reused slot")
	_check(data.brain_view[replacement.row] == view and data.brain_player[replacement.row] == player, "reuse preserves scene and behavior tree objects")
	_check(not data.sheep_has_panic[replacement.row] and data.motion_velocity[replacement.row] == Vector2.ZERO and data.memory_target[replacement.row] == null, "reuse clears previous life state")
	_check(not player.get_blackboard().has_var(&"reuse_test"), "reuse clears behavior tree blackboard")
	_check(view.global_position == Vector2(600, 400) and replacement.enabled, "reuse synchronizes spawn presentation")
	_check(service.capture(extra) and service.capture(replacement), "multiple deaths can be queued in one interaction phase")
	service.remove_expired()
	_check(data.active_count == 2 and service.get_counts() == Vector3i(0, 1, 1), "compaction does not skip consecutive deaths")
	var last_uid := dog.uid
	for index in range(3):
		engine.reset_simulation()
	_check(data.row_to_slot.size() == allocated and service.get_counts() == Vector3i.ZERO, "empty resets retain allocated storage without growth")
	var new_dog := _animal(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG, Vector2(900, 300))
	_check(new_dog.uid > last_uid and data.live(dog) == null, "reset does not recycle uid values")
	service.clear()
	var after_clear := _animal(AnimalEntity.Kind.SHEEPDOG, Vector2(900, 300))
	_check(after_clear.uid > new_dog.uid and data.live(new_dog) == null, "clear cannot revive an old handle")

func _run() -> void:
	verification_directory = "res://output/verification/" + Time.get_datetime_string_from_system().replace(":", "-") + "_" + str(OS.get_process_id())
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(verification_directory)
	scene = load("res://Levels/Map/SCN_Root.tscn").instantiate()
	authored = scene.simulation_config
	root.add_child(scene)
	engine = root.get_node("g_gameplayEngine")
	engine.set_process(false)
	await process_frame
	_check(not engine.debug_service.show_details and not scene.hud.debug_panel.visible and engine.debug_service.selected_only, "default presentation keeps overlays off with selected-only scope")
	_verify_resources_and_vision()
	_verify_population_config()
	_verify_sheep()
	_verify_grid_and_pressure()
	_verify_wolves()
	_verify_dogs()
	_verify_behavior_edges()
	_verify_runtime_config()
	_verify_controls()
	_verify_clock()
	_verify_ecs_storage()
	_verify_debug_panel()
	engine.stop_simulation()
	scene.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	await process_frame
	authored = null
	scene = null
	engine = null
	print("SIMULATION_VERIFICATION checks=%d failures=%d" % [checks, failures])
	quit(0 if failures == 0 else 1)
